nodes.list.text.t: Gniewosz reads the paper twice, the second time with a finger on the seal. He says nothing. He gets up, walks to the fire and reads it out loud, and for a moment nobody moves, each waiting to see if it's a joke. By morning they're striking the huts. One lad weeps, another swears, and Gniewosz presses a leather belt into your hand. "My captain's. He won't be needing it."

nodes.nie.text.t: "Got ourselves into it." Gniewosz doesn't raise his head. "At Crow Mountain they ordered us to charge pikemen without pikes. We didn't go. If that's hanging work, let them hang the ones who gave the orders, but I doubt you've got that much rope. Now go."

nodes.praca.text.t: "Two ways. Either we go back, but only with a safe-conduct from your captain, because without paper we'll all hang, me first. Or over the hills, where nobody's looking for anybody. I know a path, but I've nothing to feed the men on the way: six sacks of rations and someone to walk ahead, because they'd spot mine from a distance. There's no third way. Well, there is, through the captain, but then someone else gets the news."

nodes.prowadz.text.t: You walk in front all day, with thirty-two men behind you carrying sacks and not saying a word. On the ridge Gniewosz stops everyone, takes off the last scrap of his uniform and hangs it on a branch. "Let it hang. That's how it'll read in the reports." He goes on down the far side, where nobody cares who's fighting whom. He doesn't look back. None of them do.

nodes.s.options.[list].text.t: I have a safe-conduct from the captain.

nodes.s.options.[prowadz].text.t: I'm leading you through the mountains. I've got rations.

nodes.s.options.[sprawa].text.t: Once more: what can you do?

nodes.s.text.t: Under a rock overhang sits a man in a jerkin with the patches unpicked, the places where they'd been still darker. He's counting hardtack. He counts it a second time, as if something might change. "Gniewosz. I was a sergeant, now I'm a man who counts hardtack. Thirty-two lads, food for nine days, and every third day a patrol comes down on us. None of us will last the winter here, and none of us wants to hang either. You go where you please. Will you help?"

nodes.sprawa.text.t: "A safe-conduct from the captain and we go back. Six sacks of rations and someone out front, and we go over the hills. The hardtack count doesn't change, and the patrols come more often."

nodes.tak.text.t: Gniewosz nods and moves a hardtack onto the other pile. "I'm not promising gratitude, I've none to give. But the man who keeps watch at night has a grandson, and the boy will find out someday."
